# Shopify sub-actions

![Adding a sub-action: on the Actions page, click + Sub-action and search for it](../../assets/screens/actions-sub-action-picker.png)

## Catch up on Shopify orders

Asks Shopify for recently paid orders and runs Order Paid for those that never reached Cuebot (marked isReplay). Needs the Shopify API connected.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%shopifyOk%` | True when it worked |
| `%shopifyResult%` | What happened, or why it failed |

<small>Type id: `shopify.catchUp`</small>

## Get Shopify merch counter

Reads this stream's Shopify merch counter (paid orders minus cancellations and refunds) and goal, for a !merch command. No API needed.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%shopifySalesItems%` | Items sold this stream |
| `%shopifySalesOrders%` | Paid orders this stream |
| `%shopifySalesRevenue%` | Money taken this stream |
| `%shopifySalesFormattedRevenue%` | The money written nicely, like "$130.00" |
| `%shopifySalesRefunded%` | Money refunded this stream |
| `%shopifySalesSince%` | When the counter started |
| `%shopifyTopProduct%` | The product sold most this stream |
| `%shopifySalesProductsText%` | Every product sold this stream, like "3 x Sticker pack, 1 x Hoodie" |
| `%shopifyGoalTitle%` | The goal's title |
| `%shopifyGoalCurrent%` | The progress (items sold or money) |
| `%shopifyGoalTarget%` | The target |
| `%shopifyGoalPercent%` | The progress in whole percent |
| `%shopifyGoalMeasure%` | Items sold or Revenue |
| `%shopifyGoalReached%` | True when the target is reached |
| `%shopifyOk%` | True when it worked |
| `%shopifyResult%` | What happened, or why it failed |

<small>Type id: `shopify.getSales`</small>

## Get Shopify products

Lists your Shopify products (from the last refresh through the Shopify API), for a "what merch is there" command.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Name contains** | Only products whose name contains this. Leave empty for all. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%shopifyProductCount%` | How many were found |
| `%shopifyProductsText%` | Names and prices joined with semicolons |
| `%product0.name%` | The first product's name (product1.name for the second, and so on) |
| `%product0.price%` | Its price written nicely |
| `%product0.url%` | Its page in your online store |
| `%product0.image%` | Its picture |
| `%product0.soldOut%` | True when it is sold out |
| `%product0.stock%` | How many are in stock |
| `%shopifyOk%` | True when it worked |
| `%shopifyResult%` | What happened, or why it failed |

<small>Type id: `shopify.getProducts`</small>

## Get Shopify sales totals

Reads your Shopify sales from Shopify itself (paid orders, not cancelled or test ones). Needs the Shopify API connected on the Webhooks page.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Since** | This stream (since the merch counter started), today, or the last hours below. Options: This stream (the merch counter's start), Today, The last hours below. Starts as: `This stream (the merch counter's start)`. |
| **Hours** | How many hours back, for "The last hours below". Starts as: `24`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%shopifyRevenue%` | The money taken |
| `%shopifyFormattedRevenue%` | The money written nicely |
| `%shopifyOrders%` | How many paid orders |
| `%shopifyItems%` | How many items |
| `%shopifyCurrency%` | The currency code |
| `%shopifyOk%` | True when it worked |
| `%shopifyResult%` | What happened, or why it failed |

<small>Type id: `shopify.getTotals`</small>

## Refresh Shopify products

Reads your Shopify products again for the Products widget and Get Shopify products. Needs the Shopify API connected.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%shopifyOk%` | True when it worked |
| `%shopifyResult%` | What happened, or why it failed |

<small>Type id: `shopify.refreshProducts`</small>

## Reset Shopify merch counter

Starts the Shopify merch counter and goal again from zero (Cuebot also does it when a stream goes live, if that is ticked on the Webhooks page).

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%shopifySalesItems%` | Items sold this stream |
| `%shopifySalesOrders%` | Paid orders this stream |
| `%shopifySalesRevenue%` | Money taken this stream |
| `%shopifySalesFormattedRevenue%` | The money written nicely, like "$130.00" |
| `%shopifySalesRefunded%` | Money refunded this stream |
| `%shopifySalesSince%` | When the counter started |
| `%shopifyTopProduct%` | The product sold most this stream |
| `%shopifySalesProductsText%` | Every product sold this stream, like "3 x Sticker pack, 1 x Hoodie" |
| `%shopifyGoalTitle%` | The goal's title |
| `%shopifyGoalCurrent%` | The progress (items sold or money) |
| `%shopifyGoalTarget%` | The target |
| `%shopifyGoalPercent%` | The progress in whole percent |
| `%shopifyGoalMeasure%` | Items sold or Revenue |
| `%shopifyGoalReached%` | True when the target is reached |
| `%shopifyOk%` | True when it worked |
| `%shopifyResult%` | What happened, or why it failed |

<small>Type id: `shopify.resetSales`</small>

## Set Shopify merch goal

Changes the Shopify merch goal. Empty boxes keep what is there.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Title** | The goal's new name. Leave empty to keep it. |
| **Target** | The new target (items or money). 0 turns the goal off. Leave empty to keep it. |
| **Counts** | Count items sold or the money taken. Keep leaves it as it is. Options: Keep, Items sold, Revenue. Starts as: `Keep`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%shopifySalesItems%` | Items sold this stream |
| `%shopifySalesOrders%` | Paid orders this stream |
| `%shopifySalesRevenue%` | Money taken this stream |
| `%shopifySalesFormattedRevenue%` | The money written nicely, like "$130.00" |
| `%shopifySalesRefunded%` | Money refunded this stream |
| `%shopifySalesSince%` | When the counter started |
| `%shopifyTopProduct%` | The product sold most this stream |
| `%shopifySalesProductsText%` | Every product sold this stream, like "3 x Sticker pack, 1 x Hoodie" |
| `%shopifyGoalTitle%` | The goal's title |
| `%shopifyGoalCurrent%` | The progress (items sold or money) |
| `%shopifyGoalTarget%` | The target |
| `%shopifyGoalPercent%` | The progress in whole percent |
| `%shopifyGoalMeasure%` | Items sold or Revenue |
| `%shopifyGoalReached%` | True when the target is reached |
| `%shopifyOk%` | True when it worked |
| `%shopifyResult%` | What happened, or why it failed |

<small>Type id: `shopify.setGoal`</small>
